fact: DHIS2 is used by health workers regularly as part of Niger's national routine health management information system, hosted in the Ministry of Health Directorate of Statistics (DHIS2 article, quoting the Niamey Public Health Regional Director).
Niger's DHIS2 use in surveillance is boosted by its current integration with STELab, which tracks laboratory specimens and collects case-based surveillance data (DHIS2 article).
Data.FI Project refers to the national DHIS2-based health information system of Niger, to which several digital health platforms have now been connected.
Data.FI Project says a national interoperability layer based on OpenFn enables automated data exchange between three health platforms and the national DHIS2.
The health minister said health agents in integrated health centres, health districts and hospitals entered notifiable-disease data weekly into DHIS2 (ANP).
The minister said that via the national interoperability layer data from the Estelab disease surveillance platform now transfers automatically to DHIS2 without human intervention (ANP).
